sn10.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Magadhesu viharati Maṇimālake cetiye Maṇibhaddassa yakkhassa bhavane || || Atha kho Maṇibhaddo yakkho yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn10.4:2.1: [Satimato sadā bhaddaṃ || satimā sukham edhati || satimato su ve seyyo || verā ca parimuccatī ti] || ||
sn10.4:3.1: Satimato sadā bhaddaṃ || satimā sukham edhati || satimato su ve seyyo || verā na parimuccati || ||
sn10.4:4.1: yassa sabbam ahorattam || ahiṃsāya rato mano || mettaṃ so sabbabhūtesu || veraṃ tassa na kenacī ti || ||
